avis.texte: I am fair skinned and tend to burn easily. I used this sunscreen mainly for my face and neck/chest area. It worked good I did not burn and it did not make me break out. Only downside was it left my face slightly oily looking.
Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum with UV SPF50 is an extremely gentle and hydrating serum with properties that make it ideal for plumping aging skin. The spf 50 is such bonus.

I have been using this for past couple weeks and have been out at the beach several times. Not once did I get sunburned! It's easy to apply and does not leave any residue. I did have to apply every two hours per the instructions but it wasn't an issue at all, just as long as I was protected.

I have been using this sunscreen from the past 15 days and I absolutely love it. It is very hydrating and doesn't leave any white cast. The sunscreen has perfect consistency which make it super easy to blend into the skin and makes my skin glowy and hydrating without any greasy or sticky feeling. The only reason I gave this 4 stars that because sometime the sunscreen irritates my eyes.

I bought this sunscreen because the Heated Rivalry guy is the new spokesperson. He has great skin. Why not? Girl this is it!!! I sweat a lot and work outside in the South Florida heat and this stuff does not melt off and is reapplies well. Stays put.

avis.titre: It feels super light on my skin
avis.texte: I really like this sunscreen! It feels super light on my skin and glides on really easily. My favorite part is how quickly it absorbs; it basically disappears into my skin without leaving that annoying white residue some sunscreens have. It doesn't feel heavy or sticky, and the fragrance is very mild, which I appreciate. Overall, it's comfortable to wear and feels more like skincare than sunscreen. Definitely something I can see myself using every day.

avis.titre: This product is perfect in every way!
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with this sun serum. The texture is incredibly lightweight and serum-like, so it feels much more like skincare than a traditional SPF. It blends in quickly, doesn't feel greasy or heavy, and most importantly for me, it doesn't leave that obvious white cast that can make sunscreen frustrating to wear. I also really like how hydrating it feels without making my skin look overly shiny. It sits nicely under makeup and hasn't caused any pilling for me, which is a huge plus. The finish is lightweight enough that I actually don't mind applying it every morning. This is one of those sunscreens that makes daily SPF feel easy rather than like an extra step. I'd definitely continue using it, especially during warmer months when I want something lightweight but still moisturizing.
Love this sunscreen lotion! Super light formula for a high SPF, i was impressed! This is great for everyday use, doesn't feel heavy or greasy and doesn't clog your pores

avis.titre: Little hard to spread but works really well
avis.texte: I liked this. It went under my makeup nicely and really helped shield me from sunburn BUT it is a bit white casting so keep in mind if you're on the tanner side.

The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Waterproof Sunscreen Serum SPF 50+ combines SPF 50+ UVA/UVB protection with skincare benefits. ☀️ ✨ Centella Asiatica helps soothe and calm the skin. 💧 Hyaluronic Acid provides lasting hydration and helps keep skin feeling plump and moisturized. 🌊 Waterproof formula makes it a great option for beach days, outdoor activities, and humid weather. 🤍 Its lightweight serum texture makes sun protection feel easy to incorporate into a daily skincare routine. A beautiful option for anyone looking for sun protection + hydration + soothing care in one product. ☀️🌴
I love this product; it helps me prevent sunburn. It is smooth and lightweight, and doesn't leave the skin feeling greasy.

I absolutely love this product! The design is so cute and thoughtfully made, and it's incredibly easy to use. It feels great on my skin and makes using it such a pleasant experience. I really liked this sunscreen, it leaves my skin super glowy, very healthy and Korean effect. It doesn't feel heavy at all, nor does it have a eraser effect. She is very friendly when putting makeup on top

I used every day and ho working. My skin not getting oily. I like it, I will recommend for my friends.

Very luxurious, feeling sun cream, easy to apply does not leave cakey residue absorbed into Skin nicely beautiful Lite sent.

I love sunscreens and I like trying different brands. SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-cica water fit sun serum uv feels very moisturizing, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a greasy feeling. It's excellent for wearing under makeup. Now it's my favorite sunscreen. Highly recommend!

I received the sunscreen for free in exchange for my honest review. It is unscented white cream. It absorbs very fast and leaves my skin a thin shiny oily layer as the other sunscreens I have used. It doesn't make my skin dry after I have used it for more than 2 weeks. The pump of the tube is easy to use. I will buy it again.

Absolutely love this sunscreen. The number one problem I have with other sunscreen brands is does is flake after foundation is applied on top? This absolutely did not. Huge winner in my book! My only complaint is that it smells like sunscreen. I really liked this so much that I have repurchased.

Okay so first the convenience of it having a pump was wonderful, making it easy for my younger son to apply by himself without making a mess. I do love how it feels more like a lotion since it isnt beyond thick but I can feel it (not greasy) so will absolutely continue to use.
I had to go buy this because it never came in. Great product worked well on my skin

It has a lightweight texture and doesn't leave a white cast on the skin; it doesn't feel heavy, and my skin looks more hydrated every time I use it. I love this SPF.

I absolutely love this sunscreen! The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum has such a lightweight, silky texture and doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my skin. This sunscreen is very lightweight and easy to blend. I wear it as make up base and it works well with my foundation without being cakey. The scent is very light to none.

I love the formula of this face sunscreen. The texture is super smooth and doesn't pill. Therefore, it is great to wear underneath makeup, which I appreciate as someone who wears makeup almost daily. It applied nicely, didn't leave a weird cast or any residue behind, and honestly just felt like a normal moisturizer on my skin.

This sunscreen spreads easily and absorbs quickly - without leaving any white cast on my face! It's incredibly lightweight and is wonderful to layer underneath my makeup without feeling cakey or heavy. It's my new favorite sunscreen!

This might be the best sunscreen I have ever used! It goes on like a dream and is completely undetectable under a full face of makeup. My 9-year-old even loves it! It's creamy without being thick or heavy and truly feels more like a serum than a sunscreen. I have combination skin, and it works beautifully for me. I honestly think this would be perfect for any skin type.
This looked great under make up! It also felt great and didn't make me oily.

I love the look of the packaging and the ease of use the cap has, but it did make my use itchy and when I looked in the mirror I saw it was pilling. For this reason, this would not be a facial daily for me, but it could be fine as a backup for my hands throughout the day or something.

I really enjoyed the texture and feel of the serum itself, but I wasn't a huge fan of the smell! It still smelled like sunscreen which once on my skin kind of irritated my eyes as well. Don't get me wrong, I will still use it and enjoy but for the price I might choose an alternative product.

I've been using this sunscreen every single day for almost a month and I absolutely love it! I've tried sunscreens before that felt heavy, greasy, or made me want to skip SPF altogether, but this one has officially become part of my everyday routine. I genuinely don't have anything negative to say about it so far. I will absolutely repurchase!

I've been using this for about 30 days now enjoy it so far. The one flag is that I have to reapply after a few hours, so don't expect it to last all day. Cost to benefit is great and I'd buy it again. The consistency is also nice. I have not tried this when swimming, this is just walking around and sweating a bit.

This feels nothing like a traditional sunscreen. It's lightweight, silky, and absorbs beautifully without leaving that heavy, greasy feeling or a noticeable white cast. My skin feels hydrated and smooth, and it gives my face such a pretty, healthy glow.

This sunscreen is super nice. It has a nice texture that's not too thick and goopy. It absorbs into my skin nicely and also doesn't disrupt my makeup when I apply it over this product. The packaging is also adorable.

I have really enjoyed using this sunscreen on my face this summer! Every beach day I put this on under my makeup & when I come home for the day its the only place on my body not touched by the sun. It truly works and even more so it works amazing under makeup! It rubs in easily and just makes you look slightly dewy without looking wet/sticky or white.

avis.titre: Most hydrating spf i have used
avis.texte: I love the feel of this ultra hydrating sunscreen by SKIN1004. The Madagascar Centella instantly calmed my red distressed skin. Ir also delivers lightweight moisture without a sticky or heavy feel. It also helps repair and strengthen a damaged skin barrier.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I'd give the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 4.5 out of 5 stars. It feels incredibly lightweight and hydrating on the skin, almost more like a serum or moisturizer than a traditional sunscreen. It absorbs quickly, doesn't leave a greasy feeling, and I haven't noticed any white cast. I also really like how comfortable it is for everyday wear, especially under makeup. The Centella and hydrating ingredients leave my skin feeling soft instead of dry or tight like some sunscreens can. The only reason I'm taking off half a star is that the dewy finish may be a little too shiny for someone with very oily skin. Overall, though, it's an excellent SPF 50 sunscreen that I'd definitely purchase again.

avis.titre: I like this serum to protect my face & gives beautiful glow
avis.texte: This serum is great for protecting my face. It makes your skin glow soooo nice and also provides sun protection. I put it in my purse on long sun days to reapply it (I don't wear much makeup). I use this product mainly for sun protection on my face, and it is very affordable if I want to re-up in the future - but the glow is an awesome added benefit

Honestly, I am not a fan of facial sunscreens as I find most of them to be heavy and greasy. To my surprise, this one isn't. I didn't feel it was greasy or a weird layer under my makeup. I would definitely purchase again. I wore it to a Florida waterpark and i didn't get burned!

avis.titre: Best sunscreen sun serum for a nonstop mom
avis.texte: I used this on days where my kids wanted to go out and explore but my favorite day of testing was a day I did not intend for- camping! We went camping and I threw this in my bag and let me tell you know much it saved me…. I had forgotten to ( as per usual ) put suncream on myself and only proceeded to lather my kids up at 9am. Around 5 pm I realized my mistake and my skin wasn't burned at all. This is a crazy amazing product that I pushed beyond its limits and it helped up for a mom on the go with three kids and three dogs.

avis.titre: Seriously good stuff, feels like nothing on.

This is a great sunscreen! Lightweight. SPF of 50. Absorbs completely. Doesn't leave a white cast. Doesn't have a smell. Love that it has a pump. Definitely would recommend.

I applied it before my makeup and my sunscreen before everything else. I added it to my skin prep routine.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. This sunscreen is so good omg. It does not leave a white cast. My eyes are usually really sensitive but this did not irritate them. It feels really lightweight on the skin also. 100% recommended. You have to try it!!

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend purchasing this product myself!

I've been using this sunscreen for a while now, and overall, I really like it. I remember the texture feeling a little more lightweight and watery before, which I personally preferred for my oily skin, but I still find the current formula very comfortable to use. One of the biggest advantages for me is that it doesn't cause breakouts. That's especially important because I have oily, acne-prone skin, so finding a sunscreen that doesn't make my skin feel congested is a huge plus. It also works really well under makeup. I've tried it with foundations that have both water-based and silicone-based formulas, and my makeup applies smoothly over it either way. I don't have to worry about pilling or my foundation sitting unevenly, which makes this sunscreen very versatile for my everyday routine. I also love how easy it is to incorporate into my morning skincare routine. For me, it's especially useful during the hot Texas summer because I can get the sun protection I need without feeling like I'm putting a heavy layer on my oily skin. Would I buy it? Definitely. I would also recommend it to friends or family, especially anyone with oily or combination skin who wants a sunscreen that works well both on its own and under makeup.

avis.titre: Light weight and perfect for summer

This is my absolute favorite sunscreen because it's so comfortable to wear, it's not heavy and doesn't leave a white cast. It goes on the skin and get absorbed easily. It feels exactly like a lightweight moisturizer. It works really well under makeup and leaves my skin looking hydrated.
This helps during this hot weather really helps with my face not get sunburned really moisturizing and helps amazingly plus it not sticky and oily feels great on my face

avis.titre: Best sun screen I've ever tried

I also like the design of the bottle; it's very modern and the pump works great! I received this product for free in return for my honest review.

What a game changer! As someone with lupus, this sun serum really changed a lot for me with my butterfly rash on my face. It's so gentle and hydrating, while also soothing and protecting. The packaging, the formula, everything. I loved it all!

avis.titre: Hydrating Formula That Feels Like Skincare
avis.texte: I've tried several facial sunscreens, and I was pleasantly surprised by how lightweight this one feels. The texture is more like a hydrating serum than a traditional sunscreen, so it spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a white cast on my skin. It also layers well under moisturizer and makeup without feeling heavy or greasy. Compared to other sunscreens I've used, this one stands out because it feels like skincare in addition to sun protection. My skin felt hydrated throughout the day, and I liked that it didn't leave my face looking overly shiny. The only downside I noticed is that it made my eyes burn a little if the product migrated too close to them during the day. It wasn't enough to keep me from using it, but I'll be more careful to avoid the eye area when applying it.

Feels so nice on the face like a moisturizer, not sticky at all which I love. Looks amazing under makeup, its thin, hydrating and good for daily use, also it doesn't break me out, no white cast, not oily, not greasy and absorbs very well.

I was given a sample of the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum in exchange for my honest review, and I'm really impressed with it! The texture is so lightweight and feels more like a hydrating serum than a traditional sunscreen. It absorbs easily, doesn't feel heavy or greasy, and leaves my skin with a really nice healthy glow. I especially love that it doesn't leave a noticeable white cast and layers well with the rest of my skincare and makeup. My skin feels moisturized and comfortable after applying it, rather than dry or tight like some sunscreens can make it feel. Overall, this is definitely a sunscreen I can see myself using every day. It makes SPF feel like an enjoyable part of my skincare routine instead of something I have to force myself to wear. I would absolutely recommend giving it a try!

I have been using this sunscreen for over a month now, and it is the best sunscreen I have ever tried. The formula is thick, yet it smooths out effortlessly upon application. It does not leave an oily residue, and its lightweight texture makes it virtually undetectable on the skin. The sunscreen provides excellent protection, leaving my skin looking healthy and radiant. I receive numerous compliments, and the pump dispenser makes it convenient to use and carry without making a mess.

This is my favorite sunscreen . This is a solid Korean brand that a lot my friends and I use. I like that it leaves no cast and is very hydrated and light. It also has no scent either. I use this sunscreen year round. I have normal skin sometimes combo during the summer.

I use this product daily as the last step in my skin routine and before makeup. It's easy to apply and doesn't have much a scent, which I like. I wish it didn't have Octocrylene as an active ingredient, since it has toxic effects on marine species (and potentially humans) so I don't use it if I plan to swim in the ocean. All the aside, it works great and the bottle is very slim and it's easy to apply.

I really enjoyed this moisturizer. It doesn't feel too heavy or sticky and leaves my skin hydrated. I like the high spf and that it doesn't not break me out. It does irritate my eyes if I apply too close, so I have to use another sunscreen around my eyes. Other than that, I enjoyed it and will continue to use it.

I've been using this product consistently for the past two weeks. Under makeup and without. I've really enjoyed using it. it's not greasy and doesn't leave a white cast. the consistency is similar to a moisturizer which I really enjoy!

I was gifted the SKIN1004 water-fit sun serum in exchange for my honest opinion. I wear SPF daily, and makeup most days, with combination skin. I'm very fair so I often have issues with sunscreens leaving a blue cast on my skin. There are several things I really liked about this product from SKIN1004: 1.) the pump packaging fits nicely in your hand, and the pump makes it easy to "measure" how much I'm applying; 2.) the formulation is thick enough to not be messy, but serum-like enough to massage into my face and neck; 3.) no strong smell and doesn't require excessive rubbing to dry down or blend the color out. I tested the product in late July and felt the SPF protection was comparable to my typical SPF50 (no burns, no extra brown spots). I did notice that it tended to get oily throughout the day when used as a base for makeup, which didn't cause my foundation to slip but did require extra powder to blot. I got around this by setting the SPF with translucent powder prior to foundation. Overall this offering from SKIN1004 is a very nice and user friendly formula that would work for most people— I'd buy it again and have recommended it to a couple friends, especially those who don't wear makeup.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. All thoughts below are my unbiased opinion after a few weeks of consistent use. I am fair skinned and freckled so I need every bit of sun protection I can get, especially in the hot and humid summer months. I'm happy to report that this sunscreen is effective at preventing sun damage without the heavy sunscreen feel that can be present in many mineral-based options. It has a lightweight texture that blends well with bare skin and doesn't make my skin look too oily or cause any skin discomfort/breakouts; and most importantly, I did not experience any eye burn! Upon application there is a very faint white cast, which is not a deal-breaker for me, and it does have a mild "sunscreen" smell. All in all, this is a very well performing mineral sunscreen at a good price and has been added to my sunscreen "safe list."

This is the best sunscreen I've ever tried! I have oily skin, so it's important to me that the products I use have a lightweight texture and don't feel heavy or make my skin even oilier. This sunscreen has a lightweight, fluid-like texture, leaves no white cast, and blends beautifully into the skin. I also have sensitive skin and sensitive eyes, and many sunscreens cause redness or irritation around my eyes after a couple of hours. This one, however, wears really well and doesn't cause any discomfort. I will definitely repurchase it!

I adore this Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum UV SPF50 cause it doesn't leave any white cast on my skin and even it moisturizing your skin you still feel the freshness while it protect you from the sun

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The texture is lightweight and feels more like a moisturizer or serum than a traditional sunscreen. It absorbs easily, doesn't leave a noticeable white cast, and sits well under makeup. It does leave a somewhat dewy finish, so that may be something to keep in mind if you prefer a more matte sunscreen. Overall, it's comfortable for everyday wear and a solid option for daily SPF.
This didn't feel heavy or greasy and went on very smooth! It didn't make me break out either
love a hydration anything!! so thin and didn't notice a white cast. love the consistency of this i dont like when products are so thick but thats my opinion. smell wasn't strong so a plus

This is a nice sunscreen. Nothing except the packaging really stood out to me. I like that it looks like a squeeze bottle but it has a pump! Small and slim so you're not carrying around something bulky. Very very light average sunscreen smell and rubbed in nicely, no white cast. Felt hydrating and after awhile a little oily but it was a hot day so as to be expected. Didn't burn!

avis.titre: Nice sunscreen but not my first choice
avis.texte: I had used the Korean version of this sunscreen for a few years before this US version came out and while I prefer the Korean version more, it's still not my absolute favorite. It's pretty thick and moisturizing but when applied, it does give a bit of a white cast that you have to work into your skin to get rid of. The sunscreen smell is strong and smells exactly like an American combination of chemicals. It goes away pretty quickly. It does sting the eyes a little bit when removing or if it gets into your eyes when sweating a lot. That's probably my least favorite aspect of the sunscreen. All in all, pretty nice but not my first choice.

I received this product from my honest review. I have used it a few times in the Texas humid heat of triple digits. I have acne-prone, sensitive skin which makes me a difficult consumer to satisfy. I usually gravitate towards more high end sunscreens but this was surprisingly good.

There's so much about my sunscreen that I love. First of all, the SPF is 50 which is perfect for me. Secondly, there's no white cast on the sunscreen which is essential for me because I'm very tan so I don't wish to look like I actually am wearing sunscreen and lastly, I take this with me everywhere and it's so compact that it fits perfect in my emergency kit.

Y'all. This SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Water-Fit sun serum rivals SuperGoop for a fraction of the costs! If you're looking to switch to a more cost efficient alternative to SG while maintaining the same satin finish feel with no white cast, I highly recommend this product! I was pleasantly surprised to see it dries nearly unnoticeable on my brown skin with only a slight sheen compared to my skin being bare.

This sunscreen is everything I have been looking for! It gives me such a natural glow that does not feel oily at all! It also pairs extremely well with makeup!!! I recommend this 100%! It is my new holy grail!!

avis.titre: The Ultimate Multitasker: A Sunscreen That Actually Enhances
avis.texte: After testing this for over a month, I'm sold. This serum sunscreen layers beautifully over my vitamin C, toner, and moisturizer, no pilling or heaviness at all. It just sinks in and preps my skin perfectly. The biggest surprise? My makeup looks noticeably smoother and more even over it. It acts like a lightweight primer, blurring texture and helping foundation blend effortlessly. The finish is dewy but not greasy, and there's zero white cast, completely transparent on my medium skin tone. Compared to other sunscreens, this is far more hydrating than sport formulas and sits way better under makeup than most hybrids I've tried. No stickiness, no chalky residue. I would absolutely buy this. And I've already recommended it to friends with different skin types because the watery texture seems to work for everyone. Disclaimer: I received this product free from BzzAgent for my honest review.
This SPF is perfect for a day out or by the water. It's light and feels good on my skin. I love that the SPF is 50 and it's a great size to throw in a purse or bag to reapply later.

I love this sunscreen! It goes on light and smooth. It's not oily and it doesn't make my already combo skin more oily. I also have very sensitive skin and will break out immediate l'y whenever I use something new. I haven't had that happen at all in the month I've been using this! I swim every single day and have been using this on my face the whole time! I will keep buying it!

I absolutely have fell in love with this product. Not only is it lightweight but it leaves your skin protected and feeling smooth for that perfect makeup application. I highly recommend this to anyone looking to add spf to their skincare routine!

I would definitely recommend giving this sunscreen a try! It's very lightweight and moisturizing, some days I use it just by itself. It makes my skin look moisturized and glowy, rather than greasy and chalky. It also didn't burn when applied properly around my eyes. It does smell like sunscreen but not sickeningly overpowering.
